text: こ　こわい　ついでに　だいばくはつ　でも　おぼえてみる？

structure.jp: こ　こわい　ついでに
だいばくはつ　でも

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means 'try doing it and see'. おぼえてみる？ = 'want to try learning it?'

patterns.name: 〜ついでに
patterns.explanation: ついでに means 'while we're at it', using one thing as the chance to do another. こわい　ついでに = 'while we're being scared anyway'.

patterns.name: 〜でも (suggestion)
patterns.span: だいばくはつ　でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing in a suggestion means 'or something like that', offering it loosely as one idea. だいばくはつ　でも = 'Explosion or something'.
